spells.name: Reflex
spells.description:
Inflicts Air damage and increases the caster's MP.
The damage does not affect the caster.

Draws a Jack of Spades.

spells.name: Lapping Up
spells.description:
Inflicts Earth damage and randomly removes MP or AP in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

• Tails: randomness is removed to remove MP.
• Heads: randomness is removed to remove AP.

Draws a King of Diamonds.

spells.name: Yahtzee
spells.description:
Inflicts Water damage and increases the caster's Critical odds.
The damage does not affect the caster.

Draws a Jack of Clubs.

spells.name: Rough Tongue
spells.description:
Heals allies and inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

Draws a King of Hearts.

spells.name: Topkaj
spells.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies or heals allies.

Draws a Jack of Hearts.

spells.name: Playful Claw
spells.description:
Inflicts Water damage and reduces Critical Resistance in an area of effect.

Draws a King of Clubs.

spells.name: Heads or Tails
spells.description:
Inflicts Earth damage.

On the caster: randomly applies the Heads state or the Tails state and returns 1 AP to them.
• Tails: gives 1 AP.
• Heads: gives 1 MP.
• Casting the spell again in one state applies the other to oneself.

Draws a Jack of Diamonds.

spells.name: Bravado
spells.description:
Inflicts Air damage in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

The spell's damage increases with each attraction, pushback, position switch or teleportation performed by the caster.
The effects are removed after the spell has been used.

spells.name: Lucky Draw
spells.description:
Draws a random Card from Ecaflip's Poker.
Plays the Hand before Drawing if the Hand is full.

The spell's AP cost is reimbursed.

spells.name: Redistribution
spells.description:
Plays the Hand and Draws 4 random Cards from Ecaflip's Poker.

The spell's AP cost is reimbursed.

spells.name: Catnip
spells.description: Increases the targeted ally's MP or teleports the caster to the targeted cell.

spells.name: Leap
spells.description:
Teleports the caster to the targeted cell or switches places with the target.
Increases the caster's and their allies' Dodge in an area of effect.

spells.name: Jass
spells.description:
Inflicts Air damage and Draws a Queen of Spades.
Does not affect the caster.

Also reduces Pushback Resistance based on the Spades in Hand (stackable once per Card).
The spell's damage increases based on the Spades in Hand.

Plays Cards from the Spades suit if the caster initially has at least one of them in their Hand.

spells.name: Misfortune
spells.description:
Steals HP in the Water element and applies the Misfortune state on the targeted enemy:
• Inflicts Water damage at the end of the target's turn if it has not landed a critical hit during its turn.

Draws an Ace of Clubs.

spells.name: Perception
spells.description: Heals the targeted ally for each enemy in the area of effect and reveals invisible entities in an area of effect.

spells.name: Predation
spells.description: Erodes the targeted enemy and reveals invisible entities in an area of effect.

spells.name: Luck
spells.description:
Inflicts Water damage and Draws a Queen of Clubs.
Does not affect the caster.

Also reduces Critical based on the Clubs in Hand (stackable once per Card).
The spell's damage increases with each Club in Hand.

Plays Cards from the Clubs suit if the caster initially has at least one of them in their Hand.

spells.name: Nerve
spells.description:
Moves the caster closer to the target, steals HP in the Air element from enemies, repels the target and applies the Nerve state on the targeted enemy:
• Inflicts Air damage and removes the state if the target attracts, repels, switches places or inflicts pushback damage.

Draws an Ace of Spades.

spells.name: House of Cards
spells.description:
Applies a shield to the target for each Card in the Hand, based on the Card's value.

Plays the Hand.

spells.name: Lucky Star
spells.description:
Heals the target and applies the Lucky Star state on it:
• Applies a shield around the target if it lands a critical hit (stackable 5 times).

Draws a random Card from Ecaflip's Poker if the Hand is empty.

spells.name: Blakjak
spells.description:
Inflicts Fire damage and Draws a Queen of Hearts.
Does not affect the caster.

Also reduces healing received by the target based on the Hearts in Hand (stackable once per Card).
The spell's damage increases based on the Hearts in Hand.

Plays Cards from the Hearts suit if the caster initially has at least one of them in their Hand.

spells.name: Fate of Ecaflip
spells.description:
Steals HP in the Earth element from enemies, randomly attracts or repels the target, and applies the Fate of Ecaflip state on the targeted enemy:
• Inflicts Earth damage and removes the state if the target lands a critical hit.

• Tails: randomness is removed to attract the target.
• Heads: randomness is removed to repel the target.

Draws an Ace of Diamonds.

spells.name: Roulette
spells.description:
Applies a random effect to everyone.

The spell's AP cost is reimbursed.

spells.name: Ecaflip's Tarot
spells.description: Draws a random Card from Ecaflip's Tarot to apply its effects on the caster and everyone.

spells.name: Belote
spells.description:
Inflicts Earth damage on enemies and Draws a Queen of Diamonds.
Does not affect the caster.

Also reduces Critical Damage based on the Diamonds in Hand (stackable once per Card).
The spell's damage increases based on the Diamonds in Hand.

Plays Cards from the Diamonds suit if the caster initially has at least one of them in their Hand.

spells.name: Peril
spells.description:
Steals HP in the Fire element and applies the Peril state on the targeted enemy:
• Inflicts Fire damage and removes the state if the target is healed.

Draws an Ace of Hearts.

spells.name: Trickery
spells.description:
Steals HP from enemies or heals allies in the Air, Water, Fire or Earth element.
The AP cost, damage, heals and the attack element are modified randomly on each casting and when the caster lands a critical hit.

Draws a Card based on the casting conditions and the spell's element.
Plays the Hand before Drawing if the Hand is full.

spells.name: All or Nothing
spells.description:
Heals allies and inflicts damage in the caster's best element on enemies in an area of effect.
Healing increases based on the Cards on the Table, and damage increases based on the Cards in the Hand.

Discards Hand and recovers the Table.

spells.name: Balling Up
spells.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and attracts targets towards the centre in an area of effect.

Draws a Queen of Hearts.

spells.name: Claw of Ceangal
spells.description:
Repels the target, moves the caster closer to the target and inflicts Air damage on enemies.

Draws a Queen of Spades.

spells.name: Summoning Claw
spells.description:
Summons a biddable Kitten that can steal HP in the Water element, give MP and teleport.
As long as it is alive, increases the caster's Power.

spells.name: Summoning Stroke
spells.description: Summons a biddable Kitten that can heal, teleport or switch places.

spells.name: Feline Spirit
spells.description:
Teleports the target randomly and symmetrically in relation to the caster, or the caster in relation to the target, inflicts Earth damage on enemies and increases the caster's Critical Resistance.

• Tails: randomness is removed to teleport the target.
• Heads: randomness is removed to teleport the caster.

Draws a Queen of Diamonds.

spells.name: Kraps
spells.description:
Inflicts Water damage on enemies and repels the targets from the centre in an area of effect.
Also increases the caster's Critical Damage.

Draws a Queen of Clubs.

spells.name: Smell
spells.description:
Immediately removes unparryable AP to increase MP in an area of effect.
Removes unparryable MP to increase AP on the following turn.
The AP removal does not affect the caster.

Plays the Hand.

spells.name: Wheel of Fortune
spells.description:
Immediately minimises the random effects and increases the Critical odds of enemies in an area of effect on the following turn.
The effects are inverted on allies in an area of effect.

Immediately plays the Hand and discards it in order to recover the Table on the following turn.
The Hand is not discarded if no Cards are on the Table.

spells.name: Pawpads
spells.description:
Moves the caster away from the target, repels the target and inflicts Air damage on enemies.

Draws a King of Spades.

spells.name: Yowling
spells.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and repels targets in an area of effect.

Draws a King of Hearts.

spells.name: Second Chance
spells.description:
Immediately reduces the damage suffered by the targeted ally but increases it on the following turn.

Immediately plays the Hand and discards it in order to recover the Table on the following turn.
The Hand is not discarded if no Cards are on the Table.

spells.name: Nine Lives
spells.description:
Heals the target immediately and on the following turns.

Draws a random Card from Ecaflip's Poker immediately and on the following turns.

spells.name: Felintion
spells.description:
Moves the caster closer to the target, attracts the target and inflicts Water damage on enemies.

Draws a King of Clubs.

spells.name: Misadventure
spells.description:
Teleports targets symmetrically in relation to the centre, inflicts Earth damage on and randomly removes MP or AP from enemies in an area of effect.
Does not directly affect the caster.

• Tails: randomness is removed to remove MP.
• Heads: randomness is removed to remove AP.

Draws a King of Diamonds.

spells.name: Bluff
spells.description:
Inflicts damage in one or more elements based on the Cards in the Hand and Plays the Hand.
Spell damage in an element increases based on the Cards.

If the Hand is empty: Draws 4 random Cards from Ecaflip's Poker before applying the spell's effects.

spells.name: Rekop
spells.description:
Uses the Winning Hand to inflict damage:
• Four Suits or Royal Straight with All Suits: damage in all elements.
• Royal Straight with One Suit: damage in the Suit's element per Card.
• Royal Straight: damage in the best element
• Pair: damage in the best element per Pair.
• Three of a Kind: damage in the best element per Three of a Kind Card.

Discards Hand.
